svg.text: No new tokens. No new component. No icon. No dismiss control. Skins 2/3 differ only by the tokens' own values (font-ui is mono there,
which suits a filename); QA all three. Reduced motion: none to reduce — expand/collapse is an instant DOM toggle, no transition.

; entries joined with " · " after a "searched:" prefix, in issue order
↓ a basename is not a path (the no-path invariant on job_runs.detail holds); the same basename already renders on the media page
Decisions (all on ADR-095 D6 / FR9): first-query-inline over collapsed-only — the no-results state is where the owner wants the answer, and a click there is a tax;
under the status line, not the footer — the footer isn't rendered on no-results, and the caption must never move between states; ink for the query, muted for the label —
the query is the content and text-muted at 12px is already the floor of the picker's contrast budget; out of aria-live — announcing ten queries on every search is noise.
